description: This file defines accessibility-related functions and classes for WebKit in the Playwright project, including accessibility tree retrieval, role mapping, and node serialization.

classes.name: WKAXNode
classes.description: Represents an accessibility node in WebKit, providing methods for traversal, role interpretation, and serialization.

methods.name: getAccessibilityTree
methods.description: Fetches the accessibility tree snapshot from a WebKit session, optionally focusing on a specific DOM element.
